items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Crawford' and 'His daddy was', but the interviewee does not respond with any personal connection or confirmation of meeting Crawford.

ctx.x: Yeah, there's nothin' but schools. It's the height of education for Black people around there.
So there was this market for Black vaudeville. And you played the Eighty-One Theatre, the Crawford... His daddy was
